name: International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities, Revision 5
statistical_unit: economic unit assigned according to its principal activity under ISIC rules

temporal_validity.transition_note: Structure is endorsed and available; UNSD describes the formal publication as forthcoming.

hierarchy.code_semantics: One letter followed by two-, three- and four-digit hierarchical activity codes.

assignment_rules: Classify economic activity, not product, legal form, occupation or business function.
Apply the official principal-activity and statistical-unit rules.
Use explanatory-note inclusions and exclusions for boundary decisions.

official_crosswalks.notes: Direction and extent must be retained per row.

limitations: A complete ISIC hierarchy is not a complete specialist-domain ontology.
An organization can conduct multiple activities, so assignment depends on statistical unit and principal activity.
Edition 5 categories must not be silently mixed with Revision 4 data.

name: International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities, Revision 4
statistical_unit: economic unit assigned according to its principal activity under ISIC rules

temporal_validity.transition_note: Still operational in many datasets while Revision 5 adoption proceeds.

hierarchy.code_semantics: One letter followed by two-, three- and four-digit hierarchical activity codes.

assignment_rules: Classify by kind of economic activity.
Use the official production-process, input, output and use criteria and the principal-activity rules.

official_crosswalks.notes: Many-to-many and partial-code cases require explicit extent qualifiers.

limitations: Revision 4 predates newer activity splits represented in Revision 5.

name: 2022 NAICS United States
custodian: United States Economic Classification Policy Committee and Census Bureau

temporal_validity.transition_note: Proposals for 2027 updates are under review.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Two- through six-digit production-oriented hierarchy, with range codes at sector level.

assignment_rules: Group establishments using similar production processes.
Retain national six-digit detail and edition.

official_crosswalks.notes: The published Census page currently exposes ISIC bridges for older NAICS editions; do not infer a 2022 bridge.

limitations: U.S. national detail is not interchangeable with Canadian or Mexican detail.
A forthcoming edition requires temporal migration planning.

name: NAICS Canada 2022 Version 1.0

temporal_validity.transition_note: Replaces NAICS Canada 2017 Version 3.0.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Two- through six-digit hierarchy with Canadian national detail.

assignment_rules: Group producing units with similar production processes.
Retain Canada-only and trilaterally comparable markers.
limitations: National industries and specialist variants are distinct maintained views.
Digital-platform activities are classified with non-digital equivalents under this edition's rules.

name: SCIAN México 2023
custodian: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía

temporal_validity.transition_note: Successor to SCIAN México 2018.

hierarchy.code_semantics: North American shared levels plus Mexican national detail.

assignment_rules: Use the production-process conceptual framework.
Distinguish trilateral agreement levels from national detail.
limitations: Mexican national code extents require their own evidence and Spanish-language boundary notes.

name: NACE Revision 2 Update 1
concept_classified: economic activity in the European Union
statistical_unit: statistical unit assigned by principal activity under NACE rules

temporal_validity.transition_note: European statistics for 2008–2024 generally use NACE Rev. 2.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Lettered sections and hierarchical numeric activity codes.

assignment_rules: Use the introductory guidelines and category inclusions/exclusions.
Use backcasting or double reporting where time-series comparability is required.

official_crosswalks.notes: Correspondence and backcasting are separate obligations.

limitations: NACE Rev. 2 and Rev. 2.1 observations cannot be pooled without an explicit bridge.

name: ANZSIC 2006 Revision 2.0
custodian: Australian Bureau of Statistics and Statistics New Zealand
statistical_unit: institutional or producing unit under ANZSIC rules

temporal_validity.transition_note: A minor revision preserving scope, concepts and structure.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Lettered divisions and hierarchical numeric activity codes.

assignment_rules: Use primary-activity rules and detailed explanatory material.
Preserve national and regional interpretation notes.
limitations: Alignment with ISIC Revision 4 is qualified as far as possible, not exact identity.

name: UK SIC 2026
concept_classified: primary economic activity of establishments and other statistical units
statistical_unit: business establishment or other statistical unit

temporal_validity.transition_note: Final framework is effective, but ONS operational adoption is phased and National Accounts use is not expected before 2031.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Five-digit UK activity hierarchy aligned with ISIC Revision 5 and NACE Revision 2.1.

assignment_rules: Classify the primary activity of the statistical unit.
Do not label observations UK SIC 2026 until the producing system actually adopts it.

official_crosswalks.notes: ONS publishes a 2007-to-2026 table; reverse use needs explicit direction.

limitations: Final classification status and operational dataset coding status are different facts.

name: Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2025
concept_classified: economic activity of Singapore economic units
statistical_unit: economic unit assigned by principal activity and value added

temporal_validity.transition_note: Update of SSIC 2020.

hierarchy.code_semantics: ISIC Revision 5-based hierarchy with Singapore five-digit detail.

assignment_rules: Assign the principal activity using value added where available.
Retain Singapore modifications and exclusions.
limitations: Adoption of the ISIC framework does not make all five-digit codes equivalent.

name: National Industrial Classification 2008
custodian: Government of India Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

temporal_validity.transition_note: Still used in major official statistical programmes.

hierarchy.code_semantics: ISIC Revision 4-derived activity hierarchy with Indian detail.

assignment_rules: Use official NIC definitions and corrigenda.
Retain the source programme's actual classification edition.
limitations: Revision 5 activities require reviewed mappings rather than code-prefix assumptions.

name: Central Product Classification Version 3.0
concept_classified: goods and services that are outputs, transaction objects or stocks

temporal_validity.transition_note: Adopted in 2025.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Five-level product hierarchy.

assignment_rules: Classify the product itself, not the producer's industry.
Represent industry-product relations as cross-classification links.
limitations: Industrial origin is not a sufficient rule for product identity.

name: International Standard Classification of Education 2011
concept_classified: education programmes, qualifications and attainment levels

temporal_validity.transition_note: Operational international reference.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Programme and attainment dimensions use defined level/category codes.

assignment_rules: Classify programme content and outcome according to ISCED rules.
Keep programme level separate from provider activity.
limitations: Education providers may deliver programmes at multiple ISCED levels.

name: ISCED Fields of Education and Training 2013
concept_classified: field of content of education programmes and qualifications

temporal_validity.transition_note: Operational companion to ISCED 2011.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Four-digit three-level field hierarchy.

assignment_rules: Classify the subject-matter field independently from programme level.
limitations: Field is orthogonal to education level and provider industry.

name: SHA 2011 Classification of Health Care Providers (ICHA-HP)
custodian: OECD, European Union and World Health Organization

temporal_validity.transition_note: Used with SHA function and financing dimensions.

hierarchy.code_semantics: HP dot-delimited provider hierarchy.

assignment_rules: Classify provider institutional form separately from health function and financing scheme.
Allow rest-of-economy secondary providers where defined.
limitations: Provider type does not identify clinical service, diagnosis, payer or episode.

name: IRTS 2008 tourism characteristic activities (tourism industries)
concept_classified: activities that typically produce products acquired by visitors
statistical_unit: establishment classified by principal tourism-characteristic output

temporal_validity.transition_note: Built on ISIC Revision 4 and CPC Version 2-era structures.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Twelve tourism-characteristic activity categories.

assignment_rules: Derive tourism-industry status from tourism-characteristic products and activities.
Do not treat all output of a tourism industry as visitor consumption.
limitations: Tourism is demand-defined and cross-industry.
Revision 5 migration is not automatic.

name: Indicative Crop Classification 1.1
custodian: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

temporal_validity.transition_note: Current Caliper edition.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Use-oriented crop hierarchy with botanical identifiers at detail.

assignment_rules: Classify each crop once by the scheme's product/use rules.
Model end use and temporary/permanent status separately where the scheme requires.
limitations: Crop identity is not farm subindustry identity.

name: Standard International Energy Products Classification Version 1

temporal_validity.transition_note: Version 2 structure was endorsed in March 2026; Version 1 remains necessary for historical data and implementation transition.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Four-level energy-product hierarchy.

assignment_rules: Classify the energy product independently from producer and consumer industry.
Retain processing stage and physical-characteristic distinctions.
limitations: A product classification cannot identify generation technology, asset fleet or market role by itself.
Do not label Version 1 observations as Version 2 during transition.

name: Standard International Energy Products Classification Version 2.0
statistical_unit: fuel, electricity, heat, cold-energy or other in-scope energy product

temporal_validity.transition_note: The UN Statistical Commission endorsed the structure in March 2026; explanatory notes and correspondences are still being finalized.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Four-level hierarchy with 12 lettered sections in the endorsed structure.

assignment_rules: Use Version 2 only with its endorsed structure and clearly identify any still-provisional explanatory interpretation.
Classify products independently from producing industry, asset, consumer and flow role.

official_crosswalks.notes: Decision 57/121 requests finalization of relevant correspondences.

limitations: Endorsed structure does not mean the explanatory notes and correspondence artifacts are final.
Implementation dates can differ by national statistical system.

name: SEEA Classification of Environmental Activities

temporal_validity.transition_note: Update work must be tracked separately from the operational edition.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Environmental protection and resource-management domains with nested activity classes.

assignment_rules: Classify the primary environmental purpose.
Keep environmental purpose distinct from ordinary producing industry.
limitations: Environmental benefit alone may be insufficient where primary purpose differs.

name: Harmonized System Nomenclature 2022

temporal_validity.transition_note: HS 2028 correlation artifacts are already published, but 2022 remains current through this cycle.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Six-digit international nomenclature with national tariff extensions.

assignment_rules: Apply General Rules for Interpretation and legal notes.
Use national tariff extensions only within their jurisdiction and edition.
limitations: HS codes classify goods, not establishments or services.
Correlation tables are guides and may have no legal status.

name: OECD Digital Supply and Use Tables digital-industry framework
custodian: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
concept_classified: digitally enabling and digitally ordered/delivered economic activity
statistical_unit: producing unit and digital transaction characteristic

temporal_validity.transition_note: Implemented through national supply-and-use compilation.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Analytical aggregates referencing ISIC activity codes and digital transaction characteristics.

assignment_rules: Treat digitally enabling industries as an overlay on ISIC.
Keep digitally ordered and digitally delivered transaction dimensions separate from producer industry.

official_crosswalks.notes: Handbook table lists component ISIC codes.

limitations: ICT sector is narrower than the digital economy.
Country source availability may force coarser approximations.

name: Classification of the Functions of Government 1999
concept_classified: government expenditure function or socioeconomic objective

temporal_validity.transition_note: Revision is in progress and anticipated for 2028.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Ten function divisions with dot-delimited groups and classes.

assignment_rules: Classify government transaction purpose/function.
Keep function separate from producing agency industry and institutional sector.
limitations: Revision proposals are not operational categories.

name: International Classification of Non-Profit Organizations
concept_classified: type and field of nonprofit organization

temporal_validity.transition_note: Operational specialist classification based on ISIC Revision 3.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Nonprofit fields and subfields linked to satellite-account use.

assignment_rules: Apply only to nonprofit institutions within its scope.
Retain institutional-sector and economic-activity classifications separately.
limitations: ISIC Revision 3 basis makes modern activity mapping explicitly lossy or unresolved until reviewed.

name: U.S. Critical Infrastructure Sectors
concept_classified: asset, system and network criticality sector
statistical_unit: critical asset, system, network, owner or operator

temporal_validity.transition_note: Sector-specific guidance evolves independently.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Named resilience sectors rather than an exhaustive production-code hierarchy.

assignment_rules: Classify critical function and dependency, not merely establishment activity.
Allow cross-sector dependencies and multiple memberships.
limitations: U.S.-jurisdictional and non-exclusive.
Criticality status is contextual and can cross ordinary industries.

name: Open Economics: National Ocean Watch marine-economy sectors
statistical_unit: industry-geography-period observation derived from public economic data

temporal_validity.transition_note: Maintained while original employer-microdata ENOW updates are paused.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Six marine sectors with an explicit sectors-and-industries crosswalk.

assignment_rules: Use the published industry crosswalk and geographic footprint.
Retain imputation, benchmark and source-series metadata by period.
limitations: U.S.-specific and geography-dependent.
Open ENOW has less industry detail and uses imputed values.

name: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement lines of business
concept_classified: insurance market-conduct reporting line of business

temporal_validity.transition_note: Lines and definitions are reviewed annually.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Governed named reporting lines with line-specific data definitions.

assignment_rules: Classify the regulated insurance line and filing obligation separately from company industry.
Retain data-year and participating-jurisdiction scope.
limitations: Not a global insurance taxonomy.
Line availability and definitions evolve by data year.

name: GSIM Statistical Classifications Model
custodian: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe
concept_classified: classification series, statistical classification, classification item and mapping metadata

temporal_validity.transition_note: Metamodel evidence, not an activity codelist.

hierarchy.code_semantics: Object identities and relations rather than domain codes.

assignment_rules: Separate classification series, edition and item identities.
Represent correspondence and maintenance as governed objects.
limitations: Provides the metamodel, not the industry universe.
